create_mbart50_tokenizer: create an MBart50Tokenizer instance from a pretrained model with source and target language codes
build_translation_inputs: build translation inputs for the generate function with source text, source language, and target language
prepare_seq2seq_batch: prepare a sequence-to-sequence batch with source texts and target texts for specified source and target languages
set_src_lang_special_tokens: set source language special tokens including prefix language code and suffix end-of-sequence token
test_set_tgt_lang_special_tokens: test setting target language special tokens with prefix language code and suffix end-of-sequence token
